summary: A new sidebar, updates offered in the app, downloadable voices with a spoken hello, and fixes for the Mac Keychain prompt, flashing command windows and jumping cursors.
notes: Sidebar sections (Bridge, Studio, Pit Stop, Workbench, Orbit, Shield, Lab, Control) open to their pages and fold down to icons.
FBRX OS checks for new versions and offers them; Update now downloads the new version and runs the installer for you.
Voice: Fabrix says it heard you, plays a soft thinking sound while it works, and you can download more natural voices, British butler included.
The Silly Goose wears flight goggles up on his head and dresses for the season.
Mac: no more 'FBRX OS Safe Storage' password prompts. Optionally ask for a vault password at every start.
Windows: no more command windows flashing up while Fabrix works.
Typing in a pop-up no longer jumps to the first box; numbered and nested lists in answers show correctly.
